h: Soludo says backing Tinubu in 2027 could pave the way for an Igbo presidency
p: Anambra governor Charles Soludo has reportedly argued that supporting the president's second-term bid could open the door to an Igbo presidency later. His remarks come as the debate over Igbo political terms continues between Peter Obi and David Umahi.
more: Umahi earlier asked why Igbos should do only four years when others did eight.
Obi's camp has not been reported as responding to Soludo yet.
